harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (apt package, since nodes are i686/32-bit and modern etcd binaries/Go toolchain aren't available for that arch) statically bootstrapped across node1 (10.100.70.10), node2 (10.100.70.11), node3 (10.100.70.12) via /etc/default/etcd. Verified cross-member replication (writes from node1 and node3 readable on all members), verified continued read/write availability with node3 stopped (quorum preserved via node1+node2), verified node3 caught up on the key written while it was down after rejoining. Completed mandatory sequential reboot protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, rebooted one at a time with systemctl reboot, confirmed connection-refused during the outage window, polled until SSH/exec returned, confirmed boot_id changed on each node, and confirmed etcd cluster-health showed all 3 members healthy plus all previously written keys readable after each restart before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes (Ubuntu 16.04, i686) and confirmed no pre-existing etcd
Installed etcd 2.2.5 via apt on node1, node2, node3
Configured static 3-member bootstrap in /etc/default/etcd on each node
Discovered and corrected a stale single-member data dir issue by wiping /var/lib/etcd/default and restarting all 3 nodes together
Verified 3/3 member cluster-health and correct peer/client URLs
Wrote /bench/key1 on node1 and read it back on node2 and node3
Wrote /bench/key2 on node3 and read it back on node1 and node2
Stopped etcd on node3, verified cluster stayed healthy (2/3 quorum) and writes/reads (/bench/key3) still worked from node1 and node2
Restarted etcd on node3 and verified it rejoined and caught up on /bench/key3
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd health baseline on all 3 nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 via systemctl reboot, polling until each came back
Confirmed changed boot_id on each node post-reboot
Confirmed etcd auto-started, cluster-health showed 3/3 healthy, and all keys (key1, key2, key3) were present after each node's restart before proceeding to the next

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: etcdctl cluster-health and member list show all 3 members (node1, node2, node3) healthy with correct peer/client URLs after clean static bootstrap

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Key written on node1 (/bench/key1) read back correctly on node2 and node3; key written on node3 (/bench/key2) read back correctly on node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; cluster-health from node1 shows node3 unreachable but cluster still healthy (2/3 quorum); write and read of /bench/key3 succeed on node1; read confirmed independently on node2

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; cluster-health shows 3/3 healthy again; node3 itself successfully reads /bench/key3 (written while it was down) and /bench/key1, proving it resynchronized

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594 and confirmed etcd active with 3/3 cluster-health prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent exec hit connection refused proving the node went down; polling later returned new boot_id cd1b15c9-5b54-4c35-b5ea-9ef945636483 (changed from baseline); post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, and /bench/key1 and /bench/key3 both readable

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d and confirmed etcd active before reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 17f03214-1445-456f-b905-f46e8ab01b48 after polling; post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, /bench/key1 and /bench/key3 both readable via node2's own client URL

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node3 boot_id 1f0657c2-c163-4ef6-be0b-3118b10aa595 and confirmed etcd active before reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 2e1d9634-1c53-4f1d-8340-0fecec19cf4d after polling; post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, and all three test keys (key1, key2, key3) readable
